method: Independent Python standard-library byte hashing and JSON graph traversal; no uploaded code imported or executed, no restore, no tests, no network.
path_base: Sample and evidence paths are relative to unpacked; file rows and reference paths are relative to each sample's library/course_id.
reference_count_note: Reference object counts include repeated mentions in current/previous traversals, all restored JSON, and saved receipts; per-root unique file counts are separate.
limitations: Historical PID, call count and retry/probe behavior are checked against saved receipts, not a new execution.
Historical lock bytes are not preserved in phase directories; guard snapshot lock hashes can be compared but cannot be independently rehashed there.
